title: Tway-Blade
summary: TWA'Y-BLADE TWEAG TWEAK, verb transitive It is radically the same word as twitch, and of the same signification.] To twitch; to pinch and pull with a sudden jerk; as, to tweag or tweak the nose. TWEAG
